deviceScan.loadError: Unable to load devices. Make sure you are signed in.
deviceScan.requestLoadError: Unable to load after-sales requests for this order.

deviceScan.title: Device intake & dispatch
deviceScan.subtitle: One record per device · Warehouse and supplier shipping · Intake, allocation, shipping, after-sales and resale
deviceScan.orderPlaceholder: Order ID (order_…), or open from the order details
deviceScan.sourceCreated: Supply source created and linked to the default sales channel.
deviceScan.inventoryEnabled: Device management is enabled for this SKU.
deviceScan.takeoverWarning: Taking over resets this SKU's quantity stock to zero, then rebuilds stock from warehouse devices and supplier availability. Existing order reservations must be resolved first. Review before proceeding.
deviceScan.takeoverConfirm: I have reviewed current stock and agree to switch to device inventory.
deviceScan.takeoverSuccess: Device inventory enabled. Register physical devices or supplier quantities.
deviceScan.supplierHelp: Enter supplier units that have not been registered as individual devices. Registered devices are counted separately. Setting the same quantity again does not add stock twice.
deviceScan.intakeHelp: Intake devices await inspection. Available stock increases only after they pass inspection.
deviceScan.csvHelp: Headers: serial_number,imei,sku,grade,battery_health,cost_eur,currency_code,bin,notes. Uses the source selected above. Blank SKU, grade and battery fields use the defaults above. Save identifier columns as text.
deviceScan.batchSuccess: All devices received and awaiting inspection.
deviceScan.replacementLabel: Original sale for replacement (leave blank for normal allocation)
deviceScan.supplierAllocated: Supplier device registered and allocated to the order.
deviceScan.allocateHelp: Scan or select an available device below, then allocate it. Devices from different sources can be shipped in separate batches.
deviceScan.released: Allocation released. Device is available again.
deviceScan.fulfillmentCreated: Order fulfillment created and stock deducted. Enter tracking details to ship.
deviceScan.shipSuccess: Devices and order fulfillment marked as shipped.
deviceScan.cancelSuccess: Fulfillment canceled and stock restored. Devices remain allocated; release them or create fulfillment again.
deviceScan.reviewHelp: Review and process customer requests here after submission.
deviceScan.scanReturned: Scan the serial number / IMEI of the device received back.
deviceScan.receivedSuccess: Device verified and received back, awaiting inspection. The order return is synced; no refund has been issued yet.
deviceScan.pass: Pass (restock return / repaired device awaits customer return)
deviceScan.returnSupplier: Return to original supplier, do not restock
deviceScan.inspectionSaved: Inspection saved. Available stock updated based on the result.
deviceScan.repairReturned: Repaired original device returned to the customer. Tracking saved.
deviceScan.refundHelp: Select the return request above and receive all devices, then check the remaining captured balance and refund amount. Confirmation issues a real refund through the order's original payment provider.
deviceScan.refundConfirm: I have checked the request, returned devices and amount, and confirm this refund.
deviceScan.refundSuccess: Refund issued and linked to the after-sales request. Close the request after inspection is complete.
deviceScan.cameraHttps: Open the admin over HTTPS and allow camera access to use a phone camera. You can also upload a label photo or enter the identifier manually.
deviceScan.imageError: No barcode or QR code detected. Upload a clear photo of the complete label. Enter plain text manually.
deviceScan.scannerHelp: Supports label barcodes and QR codes. Scanning fills the fields; review them before submitting.
deviceScan.manualInput: Enter serial number or IMEI manually
deviceScan.manualPlaceholder: Enter manually or use a barcode scanner
deviceScan.openWorkspace: Open device intake & dispatch: allocate, ship and inspect returns
deviceScan.csvHeaders: CSV headers are missing or duplicated.
deviceScan.csvIdentity: CSV requires a serial_number or imei column. Format identifier cells as text in Excel.
deviceScan.csvColumns: Incorrect column count on CSV row {{row}}.
deviceScan.cameraError: Unable to open camera: {{message}}. Check permissions, upload a label photo or enter manually.
deviceScan.batchPreview: {{count}} devices ready to import. Review the preview before submitting. If any row is invalid, the entire batch is rejected.

deviceScan.supplierScope: Supplier account: view your own devices, maintain availability, and register, allocate and ship devices for authorized orders.
deviceScan.supplierAccountHelp: Create a dedicated supplier account with an email, supplier, authorized orders and a password of at least 12 characters. Restrictions apply immediately. Leave the password empty to update an existing account. Saving replaces authorized orders; clear them to revoke order operations.
deviceScan.supplierOrdersHelp: Enter order IDs (order_…), one per line or separated by commas.
deviceScan.supplierPassword: New account password (leave empty for existing accounts)
deviceScan.supplierPasswordHelp: At least 12 characters for a new account
